koska_reeves._comment: Koska Reeves. Setting bountyHuntUsingCost makes neutral galaxy-row units legal targets and uses their cost as the target value; GET_BOUNTY already pays out resources equal to cost for neutral cards.

A: └── Koska Reeves' ability: You can attack a neutral unit in the galaxy row using its cost as its target value. If you defeat it, gain resources equal to its cost.
{{$ALIAS_N}} tried to use Koska Reeves' ability but it cannot be activated.
